_comment: Copy this file to tools/screener_config.json and fill in your export URL(s). That file is gitignored. Get each url by opening your saved screen on screener.in and copying the 'Export to Excel' link address (right-click -> Copy link address). kind = 'screener' (the weekly universe) or 'stage2' (a Stage 2 list, if exportable). min_mcap drops tiny names from the universe.
